name: warm-path-lock-chain
title: F2 warm-path lock chain: lock-free resolve, self-traffic reorder, UDP ready path
description: Structural finding F2 of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf: one warm packet pays 3-5 serialized global locks and 5-9 dictionary probes - SelfTrafficRegistry.IsOwned (global lock + up to 4 probes) before the flow lookup, FlowTable.TryResolve (global lock + 1-2 probes + a clock call per hit), the TCP redirect table's gate entered twice per packet, and the UDP coordinator/session/transport chain per datagram. Measured: throughput falls as workers are added (scaling ratio 0.158-0.203 at four threads).
